snippet.title: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers - Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Matt was called for a long freight haul deep into Snowpine State. He didn't know he was rolling straight into a nightmare

WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4617310/Fractured_Snowpine_Strangers

Fractured: Snowpine Strangers is a psychological horror game that tells the story of Matt, a freight train driver. The constant, never-ending clatter of the wheels could drive anyone insane - but not the main character. He finds something special while being thousands of miles away from home, and every time he makes this journey to return to his family

VA: Evan Packard 
Music: seeyousoon - rest my place 

#fractured #snowpinestrangers #horrorgame #psxhorror
